root_idea.summary: The root centers on watching over, guarding, and preserving; it also has a distinct branch of returning or turning back.
root_idea.development: The guarding principle extends to tending animals, pasture, attentive observance, governance, and stewardship. A separate branch denotes retreat or returning from something.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form III verb and imperative construction.
Distinct Quran-attested noun denoting pasture or grazing ground.
The Quranic plural is presented under the singular active-participle citation form.
Distinct Quran-attested form, lexically read as a plural of رَاعٍ and also attested as a verbal noun.

senses.usage_conditions: Used with animals and pasture; the Quranic imperative in 20:54 has the sense of letting livestock graze.

senses.definition: To keep, guard, or observe faithfully; to be mindful of something.
senses.usage_conditions: Can take a person, affair, right, or obligation as its object; in 57:27 it describes failing to observe an obligation with its due observance.

senses.definition: To pay attention to, heed, or address attentively.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic imperative رَاعِنَا, the form is explained as an appeal to give attention or listen attentively.

senses.definition: Pasture: grazing ground or herbage available for animals.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote the place or the vegetation that is grazed.

senses.definition: One who watches over, guards, or tends what is entrusted to him; a keeper or shepherd.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is plural and substantivized, describing people characterized by faithful observance and guardianship.

senses.definition: Careful observance, mindful regard, or faithful keeping.
senses.usage_conditions: In 57:27, the phrase حق رعايتها means its due or proper observance.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Noun · plural active participle / verbal noun

senses.definition: Shepherds or keepers; a plural of رَاعٍ.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is interpreted contextually as a plural active participle referring to people tending livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep and tend livestock, including leading them to pasture, feeding them, or defending them from an enemy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader animal-tending use than merely grazing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To touch or feel the female sexual organ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional euphemistic use in a reported expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manage, rule, or govern people or affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a ruler, governor, or other person responsible for subjects or affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regard, take account of, or show consideration toward someone or something; to act well toward it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the related sense of facing or attending to a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To watch an affair in order to see what it will become or what result it will yield; to watch the stars while awaiting their disappearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A monitoring or waiting construction, distinct from simple guarding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Faithfulness to an engagement or promise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional ethical use, synonymous with fulfilling an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To say or invoke that God keep or guard someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II usage found in a blessing or prayer formula.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture together with other animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an animal grazing alongside animals of its own or another kind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression وَرِّعِ اللِّصَّ وَلَا تُرَاعِهِ, to refrain from waiting for the thief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported expression also has an alternative explanation involving restraining the thief and not bearing witness against him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause pasture to grow for animals, or to make a place into a pasturage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of land that abounds in herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give ear, hearken, or listen attentively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction أَرْعَيْتُهُ سَمْعِي and in the imperative أَرْعِنِي سَمْعَكَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show mercy, spare, pity, or have compassion for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is used with عَلَى in the reported construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire or arrange for cattle to pasture, especially to leave them grazing without a herder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported examples distinguish leaving cattle to pasture by night or day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or desire someone to keep, guard, or pay attention to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be used of asking hearers to attend to a speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pasture or herbage serving as the food of animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may have a plural referring to kinds or sorts of pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular herb with berries like myrtle berries, edible by camels but poisonous to certain reptiles or vermin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical botanical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of animals pasturing or pasturing by themselves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or substantive formed from the animal-grazing use of رَعَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act or occupation of keeping, tending, pasturing, or feeding camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the work of a person who tends or pastures animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of watching and awaiting the disappearance of the stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use associated with watching the stars.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land containing projecting stones that impede the plough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct geographical or agricultural noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mercy or pity to be shown to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression meaning that one has no mercy or pity to bestow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mindfulness, regardfulness, or observance of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive connected with the construction رَعَى أَمْرَهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pastured, kept, guarded, or governed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported adjective or passive-participial usage, with the lexical status noted as analogical in the source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Livestock that is pastured, tended, or kept; especially animals held under someone's care.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may refer to livestock kept for an owner or ruler.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The people or community under the rule, guardianship, or government of a ruler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same noun extends from protected livestock to subjects or persons under authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Camels that pasture around people's dwellings because they are used for their work or livelihood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural or collective designation for working camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who keeps, guards, pastures, or tends livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle is substantivized as a keeper or shepherd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of locust or grasshopper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical zoological name; another related expression denotes a different species.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of several stars associated with traditional stellar figures.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes names used for stars in or near Ophiuchus, Cepheus, Orion, or Sagittarius.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ruler, governor, prince, or commander who manages the affairs of a people; also one responsible for his own affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A political and fiduciary extension of the keeper sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Faithful to a charge, especially of carrier pigeons that reliably carry messages.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized conventional use derived from the sense of faithful care.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular small yellow bird found beneath horses or similar animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical bird name, also appearing in the compound رَاعِيَةُ الخَيْلِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The beginning or first signs of gray hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or tropical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most merciful and compassionate; by extension, more easy or convenient for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative usage with a reported figurative development from showing mercy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The yoke placed on the necks of two bulls used for ploughing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal agricultural term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in tending or pasturing camels, or habitually engaged in that work; a good seeker of herbage for cattle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Several variant forms are reported for the same occupational designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of pasturing or grazing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun use of the same form that also denotes a pasture or place of pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The guarding of palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported verbal-noun use, distinct from the plural active-participle reading ‘shepherds’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pastured, tended, fed, guarded, minded, or governed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial adjective covering things or persons placed under care or rule.

cautions: The Form III Quranic imperative رَاعِنَا is represented according to the supplied lexical explanation as an appeal for attention or listening; the packet also preserves an alternate interpretation in cross-reference context, so the English contextual gloss should not be treated as a complete lexical definition.

رِعَاءٌ is morphologically classified in the QAC packet as a verbal noun, while the direct lexical evidence also identifies it as the plural of رَاعٍ. The Quranic occurrence is presented under the shepherd/keeper reading, with the verbal-noun use retained separately under broader Classical Arabic meanings.
